subject.title: feat: add jsonl support to memory indexer

question: Should builtin memorySearch.extraPaths ingest arbitrary raw JSONL message logs, or should raw JSONL recall stay in documented QMD/session-memory/converter/plugin workflows?
rationale: Source inspection shows the missing behavior, but adding it would widen sensitive log indexing and may conflict with the repo's lean-core/plugin-boundary direction unless maintainers explicitly sponsor the core behavior.

options.title: Document Supported Alternative
options.body: Keep builtin extra paths Markdown/multimodal-only and document the QMD, session-memory, converter, or plugin-owned workflow for raw JSONL recall.

options.title: Add Native Builtin JSONL
options.body: Implement JSONL as a first-class builtin memory format with line-aware parsing, watcher and memory_get support, tests, docs, and privacy guardrails.

options.title: Design Plugin/API First
options.body: Keep this open until maintainers decide whether a plugin or memory API extension should own arbitrary raw-log ingestion.

recommendation.title: Document Supported Alternative
recommendation.body: Keep builtin extra paths Markdown/multimodal-only and document the QMD, session-memory, converter, or plugin-owned workflow for raw JSONL recall.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already gave maintainer-side context on this exact issue and has the strongest recent history on the affected memory host boundary.
